_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); defense prime contractor signals

pit_profile.why: 'In 2012, 82% of our $47.2 billion in net sales were from the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor (including 61% from the Department of Defense (DoD))' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1); 'We depend heavily on U.S. Government contracts. Our programs could be materially reduced, extended, or terminated as a result of the government’s continuing assessment of priorities, changes in government priorities, the implementation of sequestration, or other budget cuts intended to avoid sequestration.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and CLOUD (live from 2012-10-30) to public cloud displacing on-premise hardware, storage, databases and data-center outsourcing; the 10-K names no offshore competition and does not mention cloud, so no disruption theme in scope is live

classification.quality_note: 'In 2012, 82% of our $47.2 billion in net sales were from the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor (including 61% from the Department of Defense (DoD))' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1); 'We depend heavily on U.S. Government contracts. Our programs could be materially reduced, extended, or terminated as a result of the government’s continuing assessment of priorities, changes in government priorities, the implementation of sequestration, or other budget cuts intended to avoid sequestration.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and CLOUD (live from 2012-10-30) to public cloud displacing on-premise hardware, storage, databases and data-center outsourcing; the 10-K names no offshore competition and does not mention cloud, so no disruption theme in scope is live. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.36x; +64% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.79; conservative 2yr -11%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -6.9%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-1.0%/yr (FY13 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.2%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +42.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LMT (retrospective, 2013-11-22) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.36x (42.5% downside to Bear $81 / +31.3% upside to Bull $185) | Adj composite 2.02 vs market 2.81: gap -0.79 [OVERVALUED] | +64% above the EPP floor $86 (9x FY13E $9.55) | Conservative 2-yr case: -10.9% total (-5.4%/yr) | At 14.8x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $186 sits above the BULL case; backlog +4.1% in Q3 2013, forward revenues -4.6% (FY13 net sales guide); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and CLOUD (live from 2012-10-30) to public cloud displacing on-premise hardware, storage, databases and data-center outsourcing; the 10-Ks name no offshore competition and do not mention cloud, so no theme in scope has dated evidence.
